login.title: Sign in
login.emailHelp: Enter your work email. We will send you a 6-digit code.
login.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.

mfa.verifyHelp: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Daksha Nirmaan.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.cannotScan: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app instead:

users.title: Users & roles
users.addHelp: No email is sent. After you add someone, ask them to open the app and sign in with this email address; they will get a code.
users.name: Name
users.addedNotice: {email} was added. Ask them to open the app and sign in with this email.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.internal: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.code_wrong: That code did not work. Request a new one and try again.
errors.mfa_already: An authenticator app is already set up for this account.
errors.partial_disable: The person is disabled in the app, but their sign-in account could not be blocked. Press Disable again.
errors.partial_enable: The person is enabled in the app, but their sign-in account could not be unblocked. Press Enable again.
errors.period_locked: That month is locked, or not set up for accounting. Ask an owner.
errors.negative_stock: There is not enough stock in the godown for one of the items. Reduce the quantity.
errors.credit_limit: This would go over the party's credit limit.
errors.not_draft: This is no longer a draft. It may already be posted or cancelled.
errors.not_posted: This is not posted, or it is already cancelled.
errors.has_allocations: A payment is already recorded against this, so it cannot be cancelled. Cancel that payment first.
errors.no_period: There is no accounting month set up for this date.

validation.generic: Some details are not valid. Please check and try again.
validation.name: Enter a name (up to 80 characters).
validation.no_auth_account: That sign-in account does not exist.
validation.self_change: You cannot change or disable your own account. Ask another owner.
validation.last_admin: There must always be at least one active owner.
validation.max_active_users: There can be at most 10 active people. Disable someone first.
validation.admin_only_field: Only an owner can change a party's type, GSTIN or state, set credit terms or salary, or disable a party.
validation.walk_in_protected: The walk-in customer is built in and cannot be changed this way.
validation.party_type_locked: An employee cannot be changed into a customer or supplier.
validation.party_has_balance: This party still owes or is owed money. Settle it before disabling.
validation.item_units_locked: This item already has stock or bills, so its units, category and stock tracking cannot change.
validation.org_state_locked: State and financial-year start cannot change after invoices are posted.
validation.gstin_taken: Another party already has this GSTIN.
validation.party_type_has_balance: This party still owes or is owed money, so its type can't be changed to that.
validation.address_party_locked: A delivery site can't be moved to another party.
validation.email_taken: Someone with that email is already on the list.
validation.no_such_party: That party was not found, or you can't change it.
validation.no_lines: Add at least one item first.
validation.invalid_party: This party cannot be billed. Choose an active customer.
validation.invalid_account: Choose the cash or bank account the money goes into.
validation.no_cost_basis: An item has no cost recorded yet. Record its purchase or opening stock first.
validation.missing_account: A required account is missing from the chart of accounts. Please tell the person who set the books up.
validation.no_sequence: The invoice number series is not set up for this year.
validation.zero_total: The invoice total is zero. Enter a rate, or remove the empty item.
validation.date_future: The invoice date cannot be in the future.
validation.item_inactive: An item on this invoice is disabled and cannot be added to a new invoice.
validation.site_invalid: That delivery address does not belong to this customer.
validation.no_default_warehouse: No default godown is set up.

field.name_long: Name is too long (80 characters at most).
field.gstin_invalid: Enter a 15-character GSTIN (capital letters and digits).
field.gstin_checksum: The last character of this GSTIN does not match. Please re-check the number.
field.gstin_state: The GSTIN starts with a different state than the one selected.
field.phone_invalid: Enter a phone number with digits only.
field.money_invalid: Enter an amount with at most 2 decimals.
field.label_required: Enter a name for this site.
field.rate_range: GST rate must be between 0 and 100.
field.uom_same: The second unit must differ from the base unit.
field.factor_required: Enter how many base units make one second unit.
field.upi_invalid: Enter a UPI ID like name@sbi.
field.interest_range: Interest must be between 0 and 999.99 per month.
field.qty_invalid: Enter a quantity with at most 3 decimals.
field.qty_positive: Quantity must be more than zero.

field.stale_version_missing: Reload the invoice and try again.
field.account_required: Choose the account the money goes into.

errors.conflict: Someone else changed this invoice while you were editing. Reload it to see the latest version.
errors.partial: The invoice may not have been fully saved. Reload it and check the items before doing anything else.

parties.title: Parties
parties.subtitle: Customers and suppliers
parties.name: Name
parties.gstinHint: Optional. The first two digits set the state.
parties.termsOwnerOnly: Only an owner can set credit terms. New parties start with no credit.
parties.disabledNotice: This party is disabled and will not appear when billing.
parties.identityOwnerOnly: Only an owner can change the type, GSTIN or state of an existing party.
parties.creditLimitBlankKeeps: Leave blank to keep the current limit.

items.title: Items
items.name: Item name
items.isStockHelp: Turn off for services such as freight.
items.unitsLocked: Units, category and stock tracking cannot change once the item has stock or bills.
items.hint: GST rate and HSN are copied onto every invoice line when it is posted. Changing them here affects future invoices only.

org.title: Organisation
org.upiHint: e.g. name@sbi. Used for the QR code on invoices.
org.einvoice: E-invoicing (IRN) — turn on when turnover crosses ₹5 crore
org.lockedNote: State and financial-year start cannot be changed once invoices have been posted.

coa.title: Chart of accounts
coa.subtitle: Read-only. Accounts marked with a system key are used by the posting engine and cannot be renamed.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Invoices and drafts
sales.empty: No sales yet. Start with a new invoice.
sales.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches. Try another search or filter.
sales.limitNote: Showing the latest {n}. Search to narrow down.
sales.numberOnPost: Number is given when you post
sales.pickCustomerHint: Choose a customer to see their balance and tax.
sales.noSites: No saved addresses for this customer.
sales.altHint: For TMT you can type pieces or kg: the other fills in from the bar weight. Stock and the invoice keep the kg.
sales.overLimit: This bill would take the customer over the limit.
sales.walkInHint: Walk-in customer: bill as a cash sale.
sales.previewNote: This is only a preview. The books are calculated by the database when you post.
sales.confirmPostBody: {party}: {amount}. A number is given now and the books are updated. A posted invoice cannot be edited, only cancelled by an owner.
sales.confirmCashBody: {party}: {amount}. The invoice is posted and the full amount is recorded as received.
sales.overrideBody: As an owner you can post this invoice to {party} anyway. This is recorded in the audit trail.
sales.deleteBody: The draft and its items are removed. Nothing has been posted.
sales.cancelledBanner: This invoice was cancelled on {date}. The books were reversed; the number stays on record.
sales.cancelBlockedPaid: A payment is recorded against this invoice, so it cannot be cancelled here.
sales.cancelBody: This posts a reversal: the sale, tax and stock are undone. The invoice keeps its number and stays on record. It cannot be undone.
sales.cancelReasonHint: Kept in the audit trail (at least 3 letters).
